qualification: All eight assigned source entrypoints are implemented with owned CPU dependencies. No build, test, formatter, linter or native execution was run. Independent cases exercise integer statistics, calibration factors/clamping/positive and negative gain, raw triplet transfer, overlay synchronization and debug serialization. Full positive scan, noise-template model composition, asynchronous encoder integration and PFP device evolution remain separate qualification frontiers.

abi.encoderInput: Eleven words: dimensions, stride, source/destination/limit/header fields and compression/configuration pointers retain their original physical offsets. EncoderTask owns the interpreted consumer layout.
abi.resizeConfiguration: The e531ac output at 154cc90 is an 80-byte resize configuration, not an image plane. Its destination dimensions are words at offsets 56 and 60.

sourceEvidence.pixel: Pinned tu_00db5d58.c:519-709 is NONMATCHING. Complete original image5 A32 daf660..dafbec inspected. A32 dafaec/dafb00/dafb0c use logical right shifts for signed matrix products before unsigned clipping; the C draft's arithmetic shifts are not authoritative.
sourceEvidence.gamma: Complete original image5 A32 daf2f4..daf660 inspected. Nine cumulative power-of-two segment widths, three equal integer subintervals per segment, 28 output samples, unsigned weighted interpolation and output clipping.
sourceEvidence.selectors: Complete image5 A32 e530d8..e531ac, e543b0..e544b0 and ef4c84..ef4d18 inspected. Output format operation 3 executes PipelineProcessing's owned e51858 selection graph. Rate adjustment reads authenticated signed bytes at ef50e8 with a bounded RateCurveIndex.
sourceEvidence.arithmetic: Intermediate multiply/add operations wrap at 32 bits. Source uses signed division for Bayer sample counts, unsigned division for normalized sums and gamma interpolation. Signed chroma rounding adds half a unit away from zero, then divides toward zero.
sourceEvidence.outputFrontends: Complete image5 A32 e531ac..e53ca8 and e54c84..e55164 inspected. Contrary to the draft e531ac C, both capture-option bypasses write through result_pointer without a null guard. The ordinary completion path retains its null guard.
sourceEvidence.stamp: e54c6c is an exact constant-zero function. Its unreachable secondary stencil branch and unused secondary configuration reads are absent from the owned stamp implementation. Primary requests retain entry counts, 34-bit-entry data alignment, register packing and ordered PFP calls.
sourceEvidence.loader: 73b7a0 A32 confirmed: registry lookup, loaded-word test, reserved wait/signal and kernel trace only. Exact 73b238 constructs the actual zero-callback eight-byte request on channel 3c before waiting on the channel semaphore. The receiver task is not relabeled as hardware.
sourceEvidence.debugSnapshot: All 145 configuration key/getter/destination triples in e61154 were recovered from actual A32 and agree with the pinned C. One store uses ADD base plus immediate STR rather than the repeated register-offset form. The independent golden wire vector uses synthetic bytes low8((key-8c00)*37+11).
sourceEvidence.workspace: The three fixed SRAM planes are CPU scratch, not hardware endpoints. Both stock and owned numerical scenarios assert their written bytes and final interleaved output bytes. No application call scripts are present.

preconditions: The Bayer count sum modulo 256 and the three normalized sample counts must be nonzero for a returning call.
Gamma interpolation requires nonzero segment subinterval widths on the selected path.
The original pixel packing loop does not terminate for odd width 255. Admitted scenarios use even widths.
All source and destination extents must be mapped and writable where required. The original fixed workspace has no bounds check.

arithmeticFault.source: Image4 A32 89aa90/89aba8 and kernel0 4d978/4da60 choose a saturating r0 before entering retained RTOS abort 43614 -> 43604 SVC 0x1010, followed by a terminal loop.
arithmeticFault.ownedBridge: OutputTriplets_stock.S exposes only xm1_pipeline_image_output_arithmetic_fault, a fixed RTOS abort binding. No stock division algorithm is called.
arithmeticFault.payload: Unsigned zero division: r0 is zero for zero numerator, otherwise ffffffff. Signed zero division: r0 is zero for zero numerator, 7fffffff for positive numerator, 80000000 for negative numerator.
arithmeticFault.qualification: Returning arithmetic paths have independent scenarios. Native terminal SVC observation remains unqualified; no fault scenario is represented as success.

authenticatedData.reader: RateCurveIndex bounds every read to indices 0..40. Rate subtraction truncates to u8 before checking the bound.
ProfileSelectorTable::Feature bounds key/value reads to the fourteen authenticated rows.
ProfileSelectorTable::Geometry bounds key/value reads to the sixty-two authenticated rows.
Triplet tuning reads three masks and the selected value in one of four 24-byte records.
Private StampBand and StampFamily constructors restrict StampThresholdRow to the authenticated eighteen rows; StampThreshold restricts reads to the three u16 key positions.
PipelineProfileCalibration's PFP coefficient reader consumes exactly 128 words and validates each row's weights.

qualificationFrontier.outputAsync: e531ac/e53794 are implemented using ImageResize and EncoderTask CPU exports plus the owned e4e644 completion callback. Current direct cases establish all capture-option bypasses. Active asynchronous source/candidate task integration remains the parent's proof obligation.
qualificationFrontier.tripletTuning: e544b0 cases execute real rate-grid/profile-bank selection, centered buffer-view arithmetic, disabled scan component transfer and ordered RTOS priority effects. Positive scan numerical composition remains PipelineScanProcessing/PipelineProcessing.
qualificationFrontier.calibration: e54870 active independent cases compose actual factor, clamp, positive-gain and negative-gain CPU helpers, with both main/alternate and backup writes. They assert original packet holes, returned fields, rate/exposure updates and ordered task-priority effects.
qualificationFrontier.stamp: e54c84 cases establish capture-option clearing and packed/linear request construction with rendering disabled. PipelineProfileCalibration implements the complete PFP CPU/register path; actual ready-bit16 evolution and 34-bit device stencil processing remain explicit device-law gaps.
qualificationFrontier.noiseTables: e55fc0/e56030 call owned collect_settings/configure_descriptor/submit_descriptor endpoints. output_expansion.rs owns the complete d5da2c/d622c0/d5d294 CPU graph with coefficient helpers from PipelineImageReferences. OperationPredicates owns the independent OutputExpansionScenarios state law; PipelineStripPlanner composes it in SensorRequestsScenarios. No application script or empty model substitutes for those laws.
qualificationFrontier.overlayCancellation: Registry, ready/poll/wait/timeout and actual channel-3c request emission have independent cases using owned RTOS transport helpers. Whole flashloader receiver-task composition is not claimed by the sender-only model.
qualificationFrontier.terminalPaths: Missing registry units, unexpected wait errors and invalid PFP device states preserve source fail-stop behavior. Native nonreturning observations remain separately unqualified.

rawSourcePadding: e544b0 writes the raw-source address and u16 count to an eight-byte stack record, leaving its final u16 unspecified. MaybeUninit preserves that source condition. ScanProcessing copies the eight raw bytes; its numeric owner confirmed pixel consumers load only the count halfword. Models do not assert the padding.
